en: The postcard features a black-and-white illustrated view of a terrace café named 'Terrassen-Café Königin Luise.' The café is a prominent two-story building with a large outdoor seating area surrounded by a garden, many tables with umbrellas, and lush greenery. The café's name is clearly visible on the building. The scene is set against a backdrop of trees or a forest, giving it a peaceful and scenic atmosphere. The back of the postcard contains printed information about the café owner and the location, a museum stamp, and handwritten numbers.
